messages:
alex: Morning! found a handful of extra Steam keys in my backlog — thinking of turning them into a "pocket bounty hunt" for Friday's LAN. anyone down?

morgan: 100% down. what's the prize? :eyes:

alex: first to find the sticky-note on the community whiteboard gets a key. will hide hints around mezz. small games (no AAA) so everyone can join.

priya: love this. can we do a "bring-your-deck" lane? i have two extra ethernet adapters if we need wires.

jamal: i'll bring a travel router + 3ft cables. also snacks?

casey: i'll bring chips. can someone handle a simple scoreboard? i can run a google sheet.

alex: tagging @emma to check if reserved mezzanine for 7pm? @emma?

emma: booked mezz for 7–11pm. pls mute alarms ;-)

morgan: poll? router needed: yes/no/bring-your-own

poll-bot: POLL by morgan — "Router: do you need one?" Options: "I need one", "I'll bring one", "I'll go wireless". Votes: Morgan (I'll bring one), Jamal (I need one), Priya (I'll bring one), Alex (I'll bring one).

casey: ok scoreboard link: https://sheets.example.com/s/lan-scoreboard (I'll add sign-ups).

priya: can we have a "code hint" channel? i'd rather not dig through people's steam gift history.

alex: plan: hide 6 keys, 3 easy, 2 medium, 1 hard. clues on sticky notes with emojis. winners DM me for key.

jamal: can we limit to one key per person? also remote folks?

alex: one key per person, remote folks can join via lobby — i'll reserve a couple keys for remote raffle.

morgan: can we do a mini "cosplay" for bonus? :trophy:

casey: also putting up a tiny bracket for smash ultimate casuals if ppl want. sign-up sheet on the scoreboard.

priya: reminder: label cables please. last time was chaos.

alex: last message: i'll drop a tiny config snippet for router NAT if needed:

```
# travel-router quick NAT
fw enable
nat on eth0 to wlan0
```

morgan: brilliant. see y'all Friday :partyparrot:

emma: office rules: be respectful, clean up, no loud late-night music after 10:30pm.

alex: noted. see you!
